% Pattern: head/title. A second title after "and", as {\bf Notation and
% Terminology.}, names the same item, of the kind of the first title; and
% "First Proof." heads a proof, as "Second proof." does. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want head-1 definition/notation -
% want head-2 definition/notation -
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want head-3 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
Some words first.

{\bf Notation and Terminology.} We write $|S|$ for the size of a set.

{\bf Terminologies and Notations}: A set is small if it is finite.

\begin{theorem}
Every finite set is small.
\end{theorem}

\textit{First Proof.} A finite set has a largest point.
\end{document}
